'''Tatham''' was a [[Gender/Legends|Male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3640 BBY]], Tatham, fought alongside Masters [[Rubatin]], [[Joce]] and [[Injaye]] during the [[Battle of Corellia|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. When they encountered the [[Empire's Wrath|Emperor's Wrath]], Rubatin and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fought against the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], but were all defeated.
